name: Elasticsearch 9.5 Search Engine
description: Elasticsearch 9.5 search and analytics engine, security and login on.

upstream.kibana: optional add-on in services/kibana (not deployed by default: needs ~2 GB RAM)

ELASTIC_USERNAME.description: Superuser name (fixed by Elasticsearch); log in to Kibana and the API with it.

ELASTIC_PASSWORD.description: Password of the elastic superuser (12+ chars), re-applied at every start.

ELASTICSEARCH_HEAP_MB.description: JVM heap in MB. Empty = 40% of the service's memory limit (256-1024).

PORT.description: HTTP port (REST API, public domain and healthcheck).

ELASTICSEARCH_URL.description: URL for other Railway services: reference ${{Elasticsearch.ELASTICSEARCH_URL}}.

ELASTICSEARCH_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the REST API (login required).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Elasticsearch gets to flush and close shards on redeploy.
